question: Where do the SDF and MSF now sit after the repo hike announced in the October 2026 policy?

expected.quote: the standing deposit facility (SDF) rate and marginal standing facility (MSF) rate stand adjusted to 5.25 per cent and 5.75 per cent respectively, with immediate effect

reference_answer: The standing deposit facility rate is 5.25 per cent and the marginal standing facility rate is 5.75 per cent, with immediate effect.

question: What is the new Bank Rate after the October 2026 revision?

expected.quote: the Bank Rate is revised upwards by 25 basis points from 5.50 per cent to 5.75 per cent with immediate effect

reference_answer: The Bank Rate was raised by 25 basis points, from 5.50 per cent to 5.75 per cent, with immediate effect.

question: What minimum share of their required CRR must scheduled banks hold each day from mid-October 2026?

expected.quote: it has been decided to increase the minimum daily maintenance of the CRR from 90 per cent of the requirement to 99 per cent effective from the fortnight beginning October 16, 2026

reference_answer: At least 99 per cent of the required CRR every day (up from 90 per cent), from the fortnight beginning October 16, 2026.

question: What rate do primary dealers now pay under RBI's standing liquidity facility for them?

expected.quote: would be available at the revised repo rate of 5.50 per cent with immediate effect

reference_answer: The Standing Liquidity Facility for Primary Dealers is available at the revised repo rate of 5.50 per cent.

question: Under the Exim Bank credit line to the Maldives, what minimum portion of the contract value has to be sourced from India?

expected.quote: goods, works and services of the value of at least 75% of the contract price (as may be applicable) shall be supplied by the Seller from India

reference_answer: At least 75% of the contract price must be supplied from India; the remaining 25% may be procured from outside India.

question: What percentage of a hedge's notional must an AD bank set aside in cash with the central bank when a client buys dollars forward against rupees?

expected.quote: This Reserve shall be equal to 20 per cent of the INR equivalent of the notional amount of each derivative contract

reference_answer: 20 per cent of the INR equivalent of the notional amount of each contract (for contracts above USD 2 million hedging current account transactions), kept in cash with the Reserve Bank daily until the contract ends.

question: What is the new cap on positions users can take without proving an underlying exposure?

expected.quote: The threshold for each of the above facilities shall, henceforth, be USD 5 million equivalent of notional value (outstanding at any point of time).

reference_answer: USD 5 million equivalent of notional value outstanding at any time (reduced from USD 100 million).

question: Can a user re-book an INR forex derivative after cancelling it?

expected.quote: An Authorised Dealer shall not permit users to rebook any foreign exchange derivative contract involving the INR, whether deliverable or non-deliverable, which has been cancelled with any of the Authorised Dealers

reference_answer: No. An Authorised Dealer must not permit users to rebook any cancelled foreign exchange derivative contract involving INR; rollovers on maturity are still allowed.

question: For what purpose may AD banks now sell non-deliverable rupee derivatives to non-residents?

expected.quote: Authorised Dealers shall offer NDDCs involving INR to a non-resident user only for the purpose of hedging.

reference_answer: Only for hedging.

question: Who can now approve the internal guidelines for outward remittances based on online Form A2 submissions?

expected.quote: Authorised Dealers shall frame appropriate internal guidelines with the approval of their Board or any Board Committee / Management Committee to which powers have been delegated by the Board

reference_answer: The Board, or any Board Committee or Management Committee to which the Board has delegated the powers.

question: By what date each month is the non-resident deposit return due?

expected.quote: The NRD-CSR report may be submitted on or before 10th of the month following the month to which the NRD data pertains.

reference_answer: On or before the 10th of the month following the month the data relates to.

question: Which body can a bank's directors task with overseeing the ATM cassette replacement programme?

expected.quote: monitoring the progress of implementation of cassette swap may be delegated by the Board to a Committee of Executives

reference_answer: A Committee of Executives of the bank.

question: Who has lead-bank duty for the newly formed Old Delhi district?

expected.quote: 1. Old Delhi Canara Bank 03E

reference_answer: Canara Bank (district working code 03E).

question: Up to what inward remittance value can a non-individual service exporter be treated as having filed the EDF?

expected.quote: if the value of the inward remittance for such service is not more than ₹10 Lakh (or its equivalent in foreign currency)

reference_answer: Up to ₹10 lakh (or its foreign currency equivalent).

question: How much can an over-the-counter visitor send to a beneficiary's account by NEFT?

expected.quote: A walk-in customer at a bank branch can remit funds up to ₹50,000 to the bank account of a beneficiary through NEFT.

question: What makes a currency note good enough to put back into circulation?

expected.quote: A fit note is a note that is genuine, sufficiently clean to allow its denomination to be readily ascertained and thus suitable for recycling.

reference_answer: It must be genuine and clean enough for its denomination to be readily ascertained, and it must pass every fitness parameter.

question: What minimum reflectance must a ₹500 note keep to avoid being sorted out for dirt?
reference_answer: 93 per cent (with a maximum density difference of 0.04).

question: How often must the board sub-committee overseeing a payment operator's cyber risk meet?

expected.quote: primary oversight may be delegated to a sub-committee of the Board, headed by a member with experience in information / cyber security, which shall meet at least once every quarter

reference_answer: At least once every quarter.

question: What new end date applies to excluding advances against fresh FCNR(B) or NRE deposits from ANBC?

expected.quote: it has been decided to amend the date “September 30, 2026” to the date “August 31, 2026” for the aforesaid exemptions

reference_answer: August 31, 2026, instead of September 30, 2026.

question: How many old foreign exchange circulars were withdrawn in the September 2026 FEMA review?

expected.quote: seven circulars as listed at Annex, that have ceased to be operative owing to subsequent regulatory amendments, redundancy, overlap or supersession by newer directives, are being withdrawn

reference_answer: Seven circulars, listed in the Annex.

question: Which group did the Home Ministry add to the banned terrorist organisations list in September 2026?

expected.quote: Shahzad Bhatti Network (SBN)

reference_answer: The Shahzad Bhatti Network (SBN), entry 46 of the First Schedule of UAPA (S.O. 5080(E)).

question: Where should a compounding application on an overseas investment go if its UIN starts with HY?

expected.quote: 6 Hyderabad HY

reference_answer: To the Hyderabad Regional Office.

question: Which paragraph of the KYC Directions does RBI/2026-27/257 substitute to extend overseas certification to FPIs?

expected.quote: (1) Paragraph 5(1)(v) shall be substituted by the following, namely:

reference_answer: Paragraph 5(1)(v) of the Commercial Banks KYC Directions, 2025.

question: Under RBI/2026-27/261, which paragraph of the KYC Directions is replaced?

expected.quote: Paragraph 4(1)(v) shall be substituted by the following, namely:

reference_answer: Paragraph 4(1)(v) of the Urban Co-operative Banks KYC Directions, 2025.

question: Which paragraph on clearing-member legal opinions is amended by RBI/2026-27/288?

expected.quote: Please refer to paragraph 52(5) (i) of the Reserve Bank of India (Payments Banks - Prudential Norms on Capital Adequacy)

reference_answer: Paragraph 52(5)(i) of the Payments Banks capital adequacy Directions, 2025 (Third Amendment Directions, 2026).

question: Under RBI/2026-27/289, what risk weight applies when the institution clears through a QCCP for its own purposes?

expected.quote: a risk weight of 2 per cent shall be applied to the AIFI’s trade exposure to the QCCP

reference_answer: A 2 per cent risk weight on the AIFI's trade exposure to the QCCP.

question: Which paragraph on dematerialised notes and ticket size does RBI/2026-27/306 substitute?

expected.quote: Para 26 shall be substituted by the following

reference_answer: Para 26 of the NBFC securitisation Directions, 2025.

question: Which investors count as eligible for one-time approval under RBI/2026-27/277?

expected.quote: the person is a mutual fund registered with the Securities and Exchange Board of India, or a pension fund registered with the Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority, or an insurance company registered with the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India

reference_answer: Mutual funds registered with SEBI, pension funds registered with PFRDA, or insurers registered with IRDAI, that are not part of the promoter group of the investee payments bank.

question: Under Notification FEMA 23(R)/(1)/2026-RB, what replaces the fifteen-month period in regulation 5?

expected.quote: for the words ‘fifteen months’, the words ‘nine months’ shall be substituted

reference_answer: Nine months (and in the first proviso, twelve months replaces eighteen months), from October 01, 2026.

question: How does Notification FEMA 23(R)/(2)/2026-RB define a resident individual?

expected.quote: means a person resident in India who is a natural person

reference_answer: A person resident in India who is a natural person.

question: For local area banks, which paragraph of the KYC directions was rewritten to cover foreign portfolio investors?

expected.quote: Paragraph 4(1)(v) shall be substituted by the following, namely:

reference_answer: Paragraph 4(1)(v) of the Local Area Banks KYC Directions, 2025.

question: In the capital adequacy rules for small finance banks, which paragraph on clearing-member legal opinions was amended?

expected.quote: Please refer to paragraph 75(5) (i) of the Reserve Bank of India (Small Finance Banks - Prudential Norms on Capital Adequacy)

reference_answer: Paragraph 75(5)(i) (Sixth Amendment Directions, 2026).

question: What statutory power does RBI rely on to amend the securitisation rules for all India financial institutions?

expected.quote: Section 45L of the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934

reference_answer: Section 45L of the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934.

question: For non-banking financial companies, what is the smallest permitted investment per investor in securitisation notes?

expected.quote: The minimum ticket size shall be ₹1 Crore at the time of issuance as well as at any subsequent transfers.

reference_answer: ₹1 crore, at issuance and at any later transfer (from April 01, 2027).

question: Can a pension fund invested in a payments bank obtain a single clearance covering future stake increases, and how far can it go?

expected.quote: grant one-time approval to qualifying persons, either individually or collectively, for subsequent acquisitions of major shareholding up to 10 per cent of the paid-up share capital or voting rights of a banking company

reference_answer: Yes. RBI may grant one-time approval for subsequent acquisitions of major shareholding up to 10 per cent of the paid-up capital or voting rights, applied for through PRAVAAH.

question: For commercial banks, which provision on derivative exposure caps was scrapped in October 2026?

expected.quote: (paragraph 37 of the Directions) stands deleted

reference_answer: Section C 'Limits for Non-Option Derivative Contracts' of Chapter IV (paragraph 37) of the Commercial Banks Miscellaneous Directions, 2025.

question: For local area banks, which newly inserted paragraph governs how InvIT units are valued?

expected.quote: Paragraph 83A shall be inserted as under

reference_answer: Paragraph 83A of the Local Area Banks investment portfolio Directions, 2025.

question: Compare the new SDF rate with the revised Bank Rate after the October 2026 policy.

expected.quote: the standing deposit facility (SDF) rate and marginal standing facility (MSF) rate stand adjusted to 5.25 per cent and 5.75 per cent respectively
the Bank Rate is revised upwards by 25 basis points from 5.50 per cent to 5.75 per cent

reference_answer: SDF is 5.25 per cent; the Bank Rate is 5.75 per cent.

question: How does the risk reserve on dealers' client hedges compare with the one on hedging their own balance sheet?

expected.quote: This Reserve shall be equal to 20 per cent of the INR equivalent of the notional amount of each derivative contract
The FERR shall be equal to 20 per cent of the INR equivalent of the notional amount of each derivative contract

reference_answer: Both are 20 per cent of the INR equivalent of the notional, held in cash with RBI daily. For clients it applies to contracts above USD 2 million hedging current account transactions where the user buys foreign currency; for the dealer's own assets and liabilities it applies to all contracts where the dealer buys foreign currency against INR.

question: Compare the capital adequacy paragraph amended for commercial banks with the one amended for small finance banks.

expected.quote: Please refer to paragraph 85(6) (i) and paragraph 213 (2) (iv) (b)
Please refer to paragraph 75(5) (i)

reference_answer: Commercial banks: paragraph 85(6)(i) (plus 213(2)(iv)(b) on incurred CVA losses); small finance banks: paragraph 75(5)(i).

question: When do the KYC amendments for urban co-operative banks and for small finance banks take effect?

expected.quote: These Directions shall come into force with immediate effect.
These Directions shall come into force with immediate effect.

reference_answer: Both come into force with immediate effect (circulars dated September 18, 2026).

question: What did the October 2026 policy do to the primary dealers' liquidity facility rate and to the penal rate on reserve shortfalls?

expected.quote: would be available at the revised repo rate of 5.50 per cent
all penal interest rates on shortfall in CRR and SLR requirements, which are specifically linked to the Bank Rate, also stand revised

reference_answer: The Standing Liquidity Facility for PDs moved to the repo rate of 5.50 per cent; penal interest became Bank Rate plus 3 points (8.75 per cent) or plus 5 points (10.75 per cent).

question: Which paragraph of the KYC directions for payments banks was amended in September 2026 to cover foreign portfolio investors?
reference_answer: Not in the corpus: there is no payments-bank KYC amendment (only commercial, small finance, local area, regional rural, urban and rural co-operative banks).

question: What is the minimum ticket size for securitisation notes issued by urban co-operative banks?
reference_answer: Not in the corpus: the securitisation amendments cover commercial banks, small finance banks, NBFCs and AIFIs only.

question: What interest rate ceiling applies to microfinance loans?
reference_answer: Not in the corpus.

question: How much of a depositor's money is covered by deposit insurance?
reference_answer: Not in the corpus.

question: What is the maximum loan-to-value ratio for loans against gold jewellery?
reference_answer: Not in the corpus.
